name: XP Leveling
description: Tracks experience points and level, computing level-up thresholds from a curve.

implementations.note: Implemented in the consuming application; not verifiable from this repository.
Upstream module named; no adapter written.

inputs.name: startingXp
inputs.description: Experience already banked toward the next level when this component is constructed. `startingLevel` alone loses everything earned since the last level-up, which matters wherever a run is rebuilt rather than continued — walking into a new region, reloading a save, changing floor. A level and a level-and-a-half are different states and only one of them was expressible.
